material_news_signals.headline: Rams activate Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game vs. Commanders
material_news_signals.description: The Rams have activated pass rusher Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, setting up the reigning Defensive Player of the Year to return to the lineup for the first time since Week 1.
material_news_signals.body_text: for once this season it is good news on the injury front for the rams los angeles has activated pass rusher myles garrett knee from injured reserve ahead of sunday s game against the commanders setting up the reigning defensive player of the year to return to the lineup for the first time since week 1 garrett carries no designation into the matchup and rams coach sean mcvay told reporters friday that he is expected to play versus washington barring any setbacks glad to be back on the field with my teammates garrett said friday making an impact feeling their presence and just integrating back with them again garrett who helped make the rams the story of the offseason thanks to his blockbuster trade from the browns to l a has been unable to make his usual impact on the regular season with the campaign already in november following the team s season opening loss to the 49ers during which garrett logged five pressures but failed to add a sack tackle or anything else to the stat sheet the five time all pro underwent knee surgery and was placed on ir he missed the past seven contests before being designated to return practicing in limited fashion twice and taking a rest day friday now he s officially back garrett rejoins a rams squad that has far underperformed expectations billed as a superteam after aaron donald unretired to join forces with garrett and other additions such as cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson on a defense that suddenly appeared every bit as good as an offense that led the league in points and yards in 2025 the rams are 4 4 sitting in third place in the nfc west at the midway point of the season they have dealt with myriad injuries beyond garrett star wide receiver puka nacua has missed two games and his counterpart davante adams is on ir as are other big names such as kobie turner and poona ford watson one of l a s aforementioned additions alongside garrett suffered a season ending shoulder injury last week and on saturday was placed on ir despite the disappointment thus far the rams still rank 10th in points scored and 12th in points allowed and they re top five in yards both offensively and defensively los angeles defense also ranks third in quarterback pressure percentage 41 0 though it has resulted in only 12 sacks which sits tied for 26th outside of the sacks those are all good respectable numbers but garrett was expected to help elevate the rams to an otherworldly level on the active roster again with a clean bill of health he can restart his pursuit of that aim which hardly got started in one injury affected outing before surgery i think the offenses really have to pick their poison garrett said ahead of playing his first nfl game with donald who was inactive for the season opener who is going to be freed up this play i think either of us are pretty good at winning one on ones so we ll have some fun garrett donald and the rams kick off against the commanders at 1 p m et on sunday

material_news_signals.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
material_news_signals.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
material_news_signals.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

material_news_signals.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
material_news_signals.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Ravens not expected to trade RB Derrick Henry before Nov. 10 deadline
material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: any team riding a four game losing streak into the trade deadline will generate some questions about potential roster moves that is doubly so for a would be contender like the ravens who are without quarterback lamar jackson for the foreseeable future due to a thumb injury but espn s adam schefter reported on saturday that baltimore is not expected to trade running back derrick henry schefter added that the team recently informed henry it did not intend to move him and henry echoed similar sentiments about his own desires following a 33 10 thursday night loss to the jaguars i have not mentioned me going anywhere else henry said when asked if he plans to still be with the team beyond the nov 10 deadline per team transcript i m saying let s go back to work let s try to get better and turn this thing around the ravens 4 5 are staring up at the rest of their rivals in a highly competitive afc north they re currently the only team in the division with a losing record with jackson on injured reserve and backup tyler huntley toe out for the season joe fagnano was overwhelmed and ineffective in a prime time drubbing at the hands of the jags suggesting there will be little resistance to the newly acquired jacoby brissett taking over the qb1 spot moving forward after his trade from the cardinals was finalized acquiring brissett in the first place suggests the ravens are still going for it which would require all hands on deck especially those of a five time pro bowler with 13 707 career rushing yards baltimore s problems at this point go beyond the void left by jackson s injury even though a signal caller of his caliber could have helped compensate for weaknesses elsewhere the ravens defense has given up 30 plus points in three straight and henry has been stymied over the past month after rushing for 476 yards and seven touchdowns with a 4 2 yards per carry average during his first five games henry has only managed 213 rushing yards a score and 3 4 yards per attempt over his last four without a game over 60 yards on the ground during that span it s why he s far more concerned with how to turn things around and move up in the standings than the outside noise of possibly moving anywhere else the ravens have a mini bye week now to get right then henry and co have four straight games against teams with losing records before a month s worth of afc north bouts to close out the campaign we have to henry said when asked if he believes baltimore can turn it around it s the only thing we can do is go back to work and try to get it going

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots throw grand nostalgia party for 2016 team, then forget to play football
material_news_signals.body_text: foxborough mass what a festive celebratory nostalgia fueled party the new england patriots staged at gillette stadium on sunday let us count the ways 8226 a reunion was held for the 2016 outfit that rallied from a 28 3 deficit to beat the atlanta falcons in super bowl li 8226 rob gronkowski was introduced as the newest red jacketed member of the patriots hall of fame 8226 and yes that was tom brady himself in the house with ol 39 no 12 making his first gillette stadium appearance in his role as lead analyst on fox telecasts but then came the mother of all buzzkills as the green bay packers rolled to a 45 27 victory over the not ready for primetime patriots the score is misleading as it suggests an afternoon of nonstop offense and rock em sock em robots it was only some of that what the score doesn 39 t reveal is that the pats fell on their faces pretty much from the moment the national anthem was completed with drake maye throwing an interception on his first pass of the game it was the first of his three perhaps even more alarming new england cornerback christian gonzalez had his worst outing as a member of the patriots his performance so material_news_signals.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams undaunted by 4-INT night in win over Bucs: 'I'm going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
material_news_signals.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but led the game-winning drive to move to 7-2 on the season.
material_news_signals.body_text: caleb williams career high four interception night in a last second 27 24 win over the tampa bay buccaneers won t make the chicago bears quarterback gun shy i m going to throw until i can t throw anymore williams said via espn that s how i live i work my tail off to be in this position i ll never not throw the ball i could throw 100 picks in one game if it comes down to it i m going to throw that pass that i did to tight end https www nfl com players colston loveland or if it s a tighter window i m going to rip it in there that s how i grew up that s who i am i don t get gun shy that s not me that s not my identity that s not who i am with that i m going to keep grippin it keep rippin it and coach calls it it s time to go make a play the four ints were the most for williams in the nfl college or high school per nfl research chicago got off to a scorching start sunday night with williams ripping off platform throws all over the field as the bears built a 14 0 lead on two flawless drives then the interceptions started williams threw picks on three of the next four drives he got greedy on his first int trying to fit a ball to rome odunze at the goal line between two defenders his next two turnovers were poor attempts to throw the ball away the final int came when bucs cornerback jacob parrish tipped a pass and linebacker alex anzalone snagged it through it all the bears maintained their lead with a ferocious defensive effort that kept forcing punts and generated a couple of turnovers of their own chicago s fifth turnover came late in the fourth quarter when wide receiver luther burden took a helmet shot that caused a concussion and fumbled deep in his own territory tampa turned the fumble into the game tying td and converted the two point try despite the second half struggles in which chicago had a single first down on its first six drives williams let it rip on the final possession the qb converted a big first down coming out of the two minute warning then found colston loveland deep for 38 yards to set up the game winning field goal despite the displeasure i might be presenting right now there s a lot of good in terms of building this team that comes from a win like this because it s like i said one it s hard to win under those circumstances coach ben johnson said we really haven t been in that situation where in the fourth quarter with little time left needing to go and field goal touchdown whatever that is it just hasn t happened a whole lot this year and yet i feel like our guys we are prepped for that and we re ready for it that s what i know now after going through that i know as a play caller i certainly felt great it was as calm as i felt on calling plays there that last drive as i was all game long sunday marked the third time since 2000 the bears have won a game committing at least five turnovers the previous two such games came in the 2006 season when they appeared in super bowl xli williams four ints were the most by any quarterback in a win since jared goff had five interceptions in a week 10 2024 win over the texans also on sunday night football williams performance against the bucs blitzes told the story he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz then he went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives on the game winning drive he completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz they sent the same blitz a couple of times and they got through and that s what happens williams said when a defense sends a similar blitz or sends a blitz over and over that just means that they re getting through that means they re going to keep going until we stop it we have to find ways to get better we have to find ways to push through that we have to find ways when it does happen we have to make the adjustments and then when it does happen i have to be the big eraser it wasn t pretty for williams whose impressive 70 completion percentage entering the game took a hit but it didn t cost the bears a win in a hotly contested nfc north race and that s what really matters

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (right thumb) out 6-9 weeks, expects to return this season
material_news_signals.description: Lamar Jackson's latest injury has sidetracked the Ravens' 2026 season, but the two-time MVP may not be lost for the year.
material_news_signals.body_text: lamar jackson s latest injury has sidetracked the ravens 2026 season leaving them to trade for journeyman jacoby brissett this week amid a 4 5 start but the two time mvp may not be lost for the year the baltimore signal caller suffered a fractured and dislocated thumb on his right hand on nov 1 and is expected to miss at least six weeks after undergoing surgery nfl network s ian rapoport reported sunday jackson could miss up to nine weeks with his recovery which would put his return to play around the start of the postseason at the latest if the ravens make it that far rapoport reported that jackson told his teammates after week 8 that he plans to return later this season the ravens qb was initially reported to be out indefinitely with jackson and tyler huntley out for the season with turf toe placed on injured reserve the ravens were forced to start undrafted third stringer joe fagnano on thursday night against jacksonville it did not go well the ravens then acquired brissett on friday in a trade with hopes that the veteran qb can lead baltimore to enough wins in the ensuing weeks to make a jackson return worthwhile baltimore faces the chargers panthers texans and buccaneers a combined 8 21 record in the next five weeks before finishing the season with four games in the brutal afc north the ravens are currently last in the division jackson has started five games this season his first under coach jesse minter but has finished just three he left baltimore s week 4 game with an ankle sprain and missed three weeks upon his return in week 8 jackson was knocked out of the game on the ravens first offensive snap when his right hand collided with a bills defender on the season jackson is 68 of 97 passing for 967 yards six touchdowns and one interception adding 144 rushing yards and a td brissett started all eight of the cardinals games before being benched midway through their week 8 comeback win over dallas he was demoted to third string the following day and then dealt to baltimore the 33 year old journeyman has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven ints this season brissett will try to keep baltimore afloat with the expectation that jackson can return to a playoff bound ravens team and take them over the top

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Ravens not expected to trade RB Derrick Henry before Nov. 10 deadline
material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: any team riding a four game losing streak into the trade deadline will generate some questions about potential roster moves that is doubly so for a would be contender like the ravens who are without quarterback lamar jackson for the foreseeable future due to a thumb injury but espn s adam schefter reported on saturday that baltimore is not expected to trade running back derrick henry schefter added that the team recently informed henry it did not intend to move him and henry echoed similar sentiments about his own desires following a 33 10 thursday night loss to the jaguars i have not mentioned me going anywhere else henry said when asked if he plans to still be with the team beyond the nov 10 deadline per team transcript i m saying let s go back to work let s try to get better and turn this thing around the ravens 4 5 are staring up at the rest of their rivals in a highly competitive afc north they re currently the only team in the division with a losing record with jackson on injured reserve and backup tyler huntley toe out for the season joe fagnano was overwhelmed and ineffective in a prime time drubbing at the hands of the jags suggesting there will be little resistance to the newly acquired jacoby brissett taking over the qb1 spot moving forward after his trade from the cardinals was finalized acquiring brissett in the first place suggests the ravens are still going for it which would require all hands on deck especially those of a five time pro bowler with 13 707 career rushing yards baltimore s problems at this point go beyond the void left by jackson s injury even though a signal caller of his caliber could have helped compensate for weaknesses elsewhere the ravens defense has given up 30 plus points in three straight and henry has been stymied over the past month after rushing for 476 yards and seven touchdowns with a 4 2 yards per carry average during his first five games henry has only managed 213 rushing yards a score and 3 4 yards per attempt over his last four without a game over 60 yards on the ground during that span it s why he s far more concerned with how to turn things around and move up in the standings than the outside noise of possibly moving anywhere else the ravens have a mini bye week now to get right then henry and co have four straight games against teams with losing records before a month s worth of afc north bouts to close out the campaign we have to henry said when asked if he believes baltimore can turn it around it s the only thing we can do is go back to work and try to get it going

material_news_signals.headline: Ravens complete trade for Cardinals' Jacoby Brissett; deal terms revealed
material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens, the teams announced Friday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the arizona cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback jacoby brissett to the baltimore ravens the teams announced friday baltimore is sending arizona a 2027 fourth round pick and 2028 seventh rounder in exchange for brissett and a 2027 fifth round selection nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported the cardinals also paid more than half of brissett s remaining 2026 salary as part of the swap per rapoport the trade was initially reported on wednesday with the caveat that it would be finalized later in the week which has come to fruition cardinals head coach mike lafleur spoke to reporters on wednesday and stated he would let the process play out before confirming now the parties have come to terms in the aftermath of the ravens losing to the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night marking the third time in as many games baltimore had a different starting quarterback and its fourth consecutive loss undrafted free agent joe fagnano started against jacksonville after franchise qb lamar jackson started week 8 and injured his thumb on his first play back from missing time with an ankle injury in jackson s stead tyler huntley filled in as the starter but after relieving jackson against the buffalo bills huntley suffered a turf toe injury that has ended his season jackson meanwhile is on injured reserve and out indefinitely now the ravens winding road turns to brissett who presumably will start in week 10 against the los angeles chargers on monday night football brissett began this season his 11th in the nfl as arizona s qb1 he was benched following eight starts in favor of gardner minshew and shortly thereafter his trade to baltimore was reported so far in 2026 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 touchdowns and seven interceptions baltimore stands as his seventh nfl team new england patriots indianapolis colts miami dolphins cleveland browns washington commanders cardinals and will become the sixth for which he s started a game the ravens will look to rescue what s fast becoming a lost season as they owned a 12 playoff probability following thursday s defeat unfortunately for those odds brissett hasn t started a game for a playoff team since his rookie season of 2016 with the patriots the cardinals meanwhile will march forward with minshew starting and rookie carson beck in reserve and perhaps getting a shot later as lafleur s team looks to stay competitive and more importantly build for the future

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots throw grand nostalgia party for 2016 team, then forget to play football
material_news_signals.body_text: foxborough mass what a festive celebratory nostalgia fueled party the new england patriots staged at gillette stadium on sunday let us count the ways 8226 a reunion was held for the 2016 outfit that rallied from a 28 3 deficit to beat the atlanta falcons in super bowl li 8226 rob gronkowski was introduced as the newest red jacketed member of the patriots hall of fame 8226 and yes that was tom brady himself in the house with ol 39 no 12 making his first gillette stadium appearance in his role as lead analyst on fox telecasts but then came the mother of all buzzkills as the green bay packers rolled to a 45 27 victory over the not ready for primetime patriots the score is misleading as it suggests an afternoon of nonstop offense and rock em sock em robots it was only some of that what the score doesn 39 t reveal is that the pats fell on their faces pretty much from the moment the national anthem was completed with drake maye throwing an interception on his first pass of the game it was the first of his three perhaps even more alarming new england cornerback christian gonzalez had his worst outing as a member of the patriots his performance so sputtering and out of sorts that it 39 s hardly unfair to wonder if injured receiver a j brown isn 39 t the only player on this team with a contract that hasn 39 t worked out so far it wasn 39 t just that the patriots 34 lost 34 to the packers on national television they were overmatched in so many ways that it might be wise at least for a week or two to cool the jets on all that the pats can beat any team in the afc and make it back to the super bowl talk 34 it 39 s frustrating 34 gonzalez said after the game but then without even taking a breath he played off the whole thing as a bad day at the office 34 i want to be who i am for the team and everybody knows what i am 34 he said 34 i mean it 39 s football i 39 m gonna have a bad game in this profession 133 and if it 39 s a good game i say 34 all right 34 we move on it 39 s just like that there 39 s things i messed up on and we 39 ll get back to it next week 34 that 39 s all fine this business of having a bad game but even taking into consideration that gonzalez has missed time with injuries this season the fact is that this cornerback who 39 s entitled to a bad game has yet to have a great game he will earn approximately 36 million this season 34 they just got the best of me today 34 gonzalez said 34 it 39 s pro football they got good receivers like every team 34 perhaps we shouldn 39 t get too caught up on athletes 39 canned hackneyed responses that are delivered just moments after a tough loss such as when gonzalez said 34 it 39 s not the end of the world 34 even so it 39 s a bad look to reason that hey 34 it 39 s football 34 and anyway patriots coach mike vrabel had a better take on how things played out against the packers 34 we got our asses kicked there 39 s no two ways about it 34 asked specifically about gonzalez 39 s performance vrabel said 34 when your best players don 39 t play good you don 39 t have much of a chance in this league we expect a lot more he expects a lot more we need more from everybody else 34 so how does any of this connect with the fact that gronk brady and a busload of veterans from the 34 28 3 34 game were in the house maye was asked whether any of that was a distraction 34 i wouldn 39 t say that 34 he said 34 we were focused on the packers i don 39 t think there 39 s a correlation 34 maye is correct having blasts from championships past in the house doesn 39 t inspire the current team to play harder run faster etc nor does it weigh on or intimidate the opponent and yet it 39 s doubtful anybody on the 2016 patriots ever said 34 it 39 s football 34 after a bad game and they certainly didn 39 t say it on super sunday feb 5 2017 as they were being pushed all over the field by the falcons and falling behind 28 3 and speaking of 34 28 3 34 two scores were displayed on the playing surface during sunday 39 s pregame ceremonies the final score of super bowl li 34 28 and the most famous in game score in super bowl history 28 3 it would have made for a great story had the present day patriots been inspired to make a similar comeback but nothing of the sort happened the patriots trailed by a bucketload of glaring deficits including 17 0 24 7 34 14 42 14 and 45 21 to be fair the patriots have been decimated by injuries this season particularly on offense in the pass catching department that maye still managed to complete 21 of 38 passes for 299 yards and three touchdowns can be viewed as an encouraging sign but ticket purchasing patriots fans shouldn 39 t have to figure out what it means when gonzalez says 34 it 39 s football 34 after a bad loss and since we 39 re dredging up the 2016 patriots let 39 s go for broke and bring up the 2014 patriots that 39 s the year then patriots coach bill belichick a day after a 41 14 loss to the kansas city chiefs on 34 monday night football 34 famously buried that game in a ditch by repeatedly saying 34 we 39 re on to cincinnati 34 one week later the patriots beat the bengals they won seven straight games went 10 2 through the end of the regular season then defeated the seattle seahawks in super bowl xlix the patriots 39 next game is sunday against the detroit lions in munich vrabel did not come right out and say 34 we 39 re on to munich 34 after sunday 39 s loss to the packers but the patriots need a reboot and they need one quickly or they might soon find even a wild card berth out of reach new england is 5 4 barely above 500 in most seasons teams that are barely above 500 usually don 39 t make the playoffs it 39 s football this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
material_news_signals.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
material_news_signals.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

material_news_signals.headline: Giants' Devin Singletary ready for showcase as likely RB1 vs. Eagles: 'I know what I can do'
material_news_signals.description: New York Giants running back Devin Singletary, the team's overtime hero in Week 7, could be in line to lead the way on the ground this Sunday against the Philadelphia Eagles. After three healthy scratches earlier this season, he's ready for that chance.
material_news_signals.body_text: just like that devin singletary will potentially be the last man standing on sunday against the eagles the giants running back room has been whittled down from a core four earlier this season to one as cam skattebo is currently doubtful to play due to a hamstring injury tyrone tracy was placed on injured reserve and najee harris was released on oct 20 the 29 year old singletary who played the hero with a 30 yard game winning touchdown run in overtime against the texans in week 7 is ready to meet the moment i know what i can do singletary said via the new york post i want to be able to display that singletary s newfound opportunity is surprising not just because of new york s rb depth only a few weeks ago but because of where the veteran ball carrier found himself in the pecking order he was a healthy scratch fourth of four on the depth chart in weeks 3 5 though that was something new for singletary who hasn t missed more than two games in a season for any reason since his 2019 rookie campaign he maintained the right attitude i just stayed positive because that s who i am singletary said do you want it to go down like this no but it s the nature of the beast i wouldn t say it was frustrating it s how the game goes a lot of competition deep backfield when that opportunity comes you want to be ready instead of being so mad or sad that you can t capture the moment when it s here singletary finally got back on the field in week 6 against the saints as new york momentarily shifted away from its normal lead back skattebo for the outing skattebo didn t receive a carry whereas six other giants players logged at least one rushing attempt singletary had four for 18 yards plus a 19 yard reception the giants released harris following the contest and tracy injured his hamstring the following game against houston in that one skattebo resumed his typical workload handling 17 carries for 124 yards and a score but on his final attempt a 42 yarder into texans territory during ot he felt something in his hamstring skattebo slid down to protect against injuring it further singletary stepped up and he broke through for the 30 yard game winner the very next play although skattebo hasn t been ruled out he managed only a limited practice friday before receiving a doubtful designation that means singletary could very well see an extended chance to build on his big run that took place before the team s week 8 bye he would be joined by rookie gregory desrosiers and phil mafah who was elevated from the practice squad in the backfield should singletary get the start it will be his first since week 2 of 2025 a very much unforeseen development for the eight year vet hoping to stack some success for big blue

material_news_signals.headline: Nick Sirianni not ruling out staff changes during Eagles' bye week following 7th consecutive loss
material_news_signals.description: The Philadelphia Eagles lost their seventh consecutive game, falling 19-11 to the New York Giants on Sunday afternoon.
material_news_signals.body_text: the philadelphia eagles head into the bye week spiraling losers of seven straight including sunday s 19 11 defeat to the new york giants with the trade deadline approaching the roster could look different when the club returns coach nick sirianni also didn t rule out staffing changes over the week off we ll talk sirianni said via espn obviously right now my job is to be there for our guys and to go watch the tape and go look through everything i ll do anything i can to help this team win football games i ll look at myself internally first and then go from there my job is to coach the players and to coach the coaches and anything i can do to help this team win games we ll do everything can always be on the table but i don t think you change just to change because that s what your record says that you ve got to look at what s really real and not react to anything else with the playoffs a pipe dream at this point the eagles are obvious sellers ahead of tuesday s trade deadline even if howie roseman doesn t gut the entire roster at the very least players on expiring contracts such as tight end dallas goedert corner tariq woolen and defensive tackle moro ojomo should garner trade interest the offensive struggles have been the no 1 reason behind the eagles plummet both before and after jalen hurts went down with blood clots sean mannion a 34 year old first time play caller hasn t had a handle on what the offense does well or how he wants to frame game plans the instability up front has been one big issue the offensive line has struggled from the onset lane johnson s retirement stung and the club jettisoned cam jurgens after the center s struggles continued the ground game has been horrific and whoever has been under center has struggled to generate positive plays after entering sunday s game with the league s worst three and out rate the joe milton led offense failed to earn a first down on seven drives in the loss to the giants milton took over for an ineffective tanner mckee while the offense tried to stretch the field a bit more and milton used his legs well it looked like an operation led by a qb making his first start after being in town for only a few weeks philly has had to operate at times without key players from hurts to johnson to devonta smith to saquon barkley and others however it s been more than just injuries that have stymied the eagles offense mannion and offensive line coach chris kuper are squarely in the crosshairs of criticism heading into the bye obviously none of us offensively have done a good enough job we re not going to sit here as coaches and it s not sean it s all of us and it starts with me sirianni said i think the correct question there to me is do you think you ve done a good enough job obviously i haven t done a good enough job we all have things that we ve got to get better at and we ve got to figure it out on offense if sirianni plans to make an in season change to his coaching staff the bye week makes the most sense to pull the trigger

material_news_signals.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
material_news_signals.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

material_news_signals.headline: Pats' TreVeyon Henderson says he was hospitalized after 'unusual' emergency; RB focused on recovery
material_news_signals.description: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson said in a statement Friday that he was recently hospitalized after experiencing "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency" and is currently focused on his recovery and "long-term well-being."
material_news_signals.body_text: new england patriots running back treveyon henderson said in a statement released friday that he was recently hospitalized after experiencing a medical emergency and is currently focused on his recovery and long term well being recently i experienced an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms that required hospitalization for several days henderson wrote during that time i underwent extensive medical testing and evaluation while the results of my comprehensive medical testing have come back positive and reassuring the cause of this remains unknown and unexplainable henderson missed new england s week 8 win over miami due to what the team called an illness henderson has not practiced since oct 28 he was added to the injury report with an illness on oct 29 the former ohio state back suffered a high ankle sprain in new england s week 5 win over las vegas and was expected to miss multiple games but played the very next week in a victory over the rival jets henderson s most recent appearance was in the patriots week 7 loss to chicago on oct 22 logging five touches for 23 yards on 12 snaps henderson said in his statement on friday that he continues to work with specialists and physical therapists to focus on my recovery as these symptoms have affected my strength coordination and some material_news_signals.description: The Rams have activated pass rusher Myles Garrett (knee) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders, setting up the reigning Defensive Player of the Year to return to the lineup for the first time since Week 1.
material_news_signals.body_text: for once this season it is good news on the injury front for the rams los angeles has activated pass rusher myles garrett knee from injured reserve ahead of sunday s game against the commanders setting up the reigning defensive player of the year to return to the lineup for the first time since week 1 garrett carries no designation into the matchup and rams coach sean mcvay told reporters friday that he is expected to play versus washington barring any setbacks glad to be back on the field with my teammates garrett said friday making an impact feeling their presence and just integrating back with them again garrett who helped make the rams the story of the offseason thanks to his blockbuster trade from the browns to l a has been unable to make his usual impact on the regular season with the campaign already in november following the team s season opening loss to the 49ers during which garrett logged five pressures but failed to add a sack tackle or anything else to the stat sheet the five time all pro underwent knee surgery and was placed on ir he missed the past seven contests before being designated to return practicing in limited fashion twice and taking a rest day friday now he s officially back garrett rejoins a rams squad that has far underperformed expectations billed as a superteam after aaron donald unretired to join forces with garrett and other additions such as cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson on a defense that suddenly appeared every bit as good as an offense that led the league in points and yards in 2025 the rams are 4 4 sitting in third place in the nfc west at the midway point of the season they have dealt with myriad injuries beyond garrett star wide receiver puka nacua has missed two games and his counterpart davante adams is on ir as are other big names such as kobie turner and poona ford watson one of l a s aforementioned additions alongside garrett suffered a season ending shoulder injury last week and on saturday was placed on ir despite the disappointment thus far the rams still rank 10th in points scored and 12th in points allowed and they re top five in yards both offensively and defensively los angeles defense also ranks third in quarterback pressure percentage 41 0 though it has resulted in only 12 sacks which sits tied for 26th outside of the sacks those are all good respectable numbers but garrett was expected to help elevate the rams to an otherworldly level on the active roster again with a clean bill of health he can restart his pursuit of that aim which hardly got started in one injury affected outing before surgery i think the offenses really have to pick their poison garrett said ahead of playing his first nfl game with donald who was inactive for the season opener who is going to be freed up this play i think either of us are pretty good at winning one on ones so we ll have some fun garrett donald and the rams kick off against the commanders at 1 p m et on sunday

material_news_signals.description: The Philadelphia Eagles lost their seventh consecutive game, falling 19-11 to the New York Giants on Sunday afternoon.
material_news_signals.body_text: the philadelphia eagles head into the bye week spiraling losers of seven straight including sunday s 19 11 defeat to the new york giants with the trade deadline approaching the roster could look different when the club returns coach nick sirianni also didn t rule out staffing changes over the week off we ll talk sirianni said via espn obviously right now my job is to be there for our guys and to go watch the tape and go look through everything i ll do anything i can to help this team win football games i ll look at myself internally first and then go from there my job is to coach the players and to coach the coaches and anything i can do to help this team win games we ll do everything can always be on the table but i don t think you change just to change because that s what your record says that you ve got to look at what s really real and not react to anything else with the playoffs a pipe dream at this point the eagles are obvious sellers ahead of tuesday s trade deadline even if howie roseman doesn t gut the entire roster at the very least players on expiring contracts such as tight end dallas goedert corner tariq woolen and defensive tackle moro ojomo should garner trade interest the offensive struggles have been the no 1 reason behind the eagles plummet both before and after jalen hurts went down with blood clots sean mannion a 34 year old first time play caller hasn t had a handle on what the offense does well or how he wants to frame game plans the instability up front has been one big issue the offensive line has struggled from the onset lane johnson s retirement stung and the club jettisoned cam jurgens after the center s struggles continued the ground game has been horrific and whoever has been under center has struggled to generate positive plays after entering sunday s game with the league s worst three and out rate the joe milton led offense failed to earn a first down on seven drives in the loss to the giants milton took over for an ineffective tanner mckee while the offense tried to stretch the field a bit more and milton used his legs well it looked like an operation led by a qb making his first start after being in town for only a few weeks philly has had to operate at times without key players from hurts to johnson to devonta smith to saquon barkley and others however it s been more than just injuries that have stymied the eagles offense mannion and offensive line coach chris kuper are squarely in the crosshairs of criticism heading into the bye obviously none of us offensively have done a good enough job we re not going to sit here as coaches and it s not sean it s all of us and it starts with me sirianni said i think the correct question there to me is do you think you ve done a good enough job obviously i haven t done a good enough job we all have things that we ve got to get better at and we ve got to figure it out on offense if sirianni plans to make an in season change to his coaching staff the bye week makes the most sense to pull the trigger

him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Giants' Devin Singletary ready for showcase as likely RB1 vs. Eagles: 'I know what I can do'
material_news_signals.description: New York Giants running back Devin Singletary, the team's overtime hero in Week 7, could be in line to lead the way on the ground this Sunday against the Philadelphia Eagles. After three healthy scratches earlier this season, he's ready for that chance.
material_news_signals.body_text: just like that devin singletary will potentially be the last man standing on sunday against the eagles the giants running back room has been whittled down from a core four earlier this season to one as cam skattebo is currently doubtful to play due to a hamstring injury tyrone tracy was placed on injured reserve and najee harris was released on oct 20 the 29 year old singletary who played the hero with a 30 yard game winning touchdown run in overtime against the texans in week 7 is ready to meet the moment i know what i can do singletary said via the new york post i want to be able to display that singletary s newfound opportunity is surprising not just because of new york s rb depth only a few weeks ago but because of where the veteran ball carrier found himself in the pecking order he was a healthy scratch fourth of four on the depth chart in weeks 3 5 though that was something new for singletary who hasn t missed more than two games in a season for any reason since his 2019 rookie campaign he maintained the right attitude i just stayed positive because that s who i am singletary said do you want it to go down like this no but it s the nature of the beast i wouldn t say it was frustrating it s how the game goes a lot of competition deep backfield when that opportunity comes you want to be ready instead of being so mad or sad that you can t capture the moment when it s here singletary finally got back on the field in week 6 against the saints as new york momentarily shifted away from its normal lead back skattebo for the outing skattebo didn t receive a carry whereas six other giants players logged at least one rushing attempt singletary had four for 18 yards plus a 19 yard reception the giants released harris following the contest and tracy injured his hamstring the following game against houston in that one skattebo resumed his typical workload handling 17 carries for 124 yards and a score but on his final attempt a 42 yarder into texans territory during ot he felt something in his hamstring skattebo slid down to protect against injuring it further singletary stepped up and he broke through for the 30 yard game winner the very next play although skattebo hasn t been ruled out he managed only a limited practice friday before receiving a doubtful designation that means singletary could very well see an extended chance to build on his big run that took place before the team s week 8 bye he would be joined by rookie gregory desrosiers and phil mafah who was elevated from the practice squad in the backfield should singletary get the start it will be his first since week 2 of 2025 a very much unforeseen development for the eight year vet hoping to stack some success for big blue

material_news_signals.headline: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring), LT Kelvin Banks (ankle) from IR
material_news_signals.description: The New Orleans Saints plan to activate wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. from injured reserve, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported Saturday. The team has since announced activating both players.
material_news_signals.body_text: offensive reinforcements are coming for the saints new orleans is activating wide receiver jordyn tyson and left tackle kelvin banks from injured reserve espn s jeremy fowler reported saturday the team announced both roster moves shortly after tyson the no 8 overall pick in the 2026 draft is the splashier name coming back he was limited all week as he geared up for his return from a hamstring injury that wiped out the first half of his rookie season one of two top 10 wr picks in april s draft tyson hauled in 158 receptions for 2 282 yards and 22 touchdowns across four collegiate seasons split between arizona state and colorado he joined new orleans expected to form one of the next great pass catching duos with chris olave but a training camp hamstring injury delayed a look at how the pair would fare together running routes for quarterback tyler shough the 22 year old will mix back into action alongside olave the team leader with 49 catches and 636 yards as well as devaughn vele and tight end juwan johnson banks return so soon is a pleasant surprise as the standout left tackle suffered a severe high ankle sprain in week 2 that required surgery he spent only six weeks on ir however and his re entry to the lineup should be a boon for shough who could be in line for a bit better protection after seeing a pressure rate of 35 3 this season 17th among qbs new orleans getting some potential difference makers back is massive for a club that sits at the bottom of a still winnable nfc south the saints are 2 5 but they re only one game back of the other three teams in the win column the falcons 3 5 the buccaneers 3 5 and the panthers 3 4 coming out of their bye week much healthier it s now or never for the saints if they re to start climbing out of the hole they dug themselves new orleans kicks off against the browns at 1 p m et on sunday
