material_news_signals.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
material_news_signals.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.headline: Lions win for Jack Campbell as their defense gives reason to believe again
material_news_signals.body_text: miami gardens fla he wasn 39 t there but he was he was on their minds in the week leading up to an emotional game his name was on their backs as they walked inside hard rock stadium ready to play for him and his signature no 46 jersey rested in the visitors 39 locker room a not so subtle reminder of the message this week it was all part of a collective collaborative effort by the detroit lions to pay homage to jack campbell 34 today was dedicated to 46 man 34 lions linebacker derrick barnes said after his defense lifted the lions to a 19 9 win over the dolphins it was an emotional week at 222 republic drive players and coaches on this team felt helpless watching campbell unable to move during last week 39 s game against the vikings on a tackle considered routine in nature campbell was in the vicinity of the ball as we 39 ve come to expect but he didn 39 t emerge players noticed they called for help and athletic trainers and medical professionals ran to his aid they kept waiting for him to get up he always gets up and when he didn 39 t they knew something was wrong campbell was placed on a spinal board then on a cart and was later transported to detroit 39 s henry ford hospital listed as a neck injury campbell lost movement as scary a situation as you 39 ll see unfold at ford field lions coach dan campbell doing his best to navigate news as it came in said the lions couldn 39 t shy away from the cloud created by campbell 39 s absence they acknowledged the injury and the violent nature of this game they broached the topic with sensitivity offering resources for players if needed it was hard to focus on football for much of the week however in a statement released by campbell and his family on wednesday campbell said he has since regained all movement of his lower body and was making progress on regaining movement of his upper body for his teammates who didn 39 t know what sort of future campbell could live the news offered them a chance to exhale move forward and shift their focus back to football and so the message this week was simple prepare and play like 46 34 it 39 s all we could do 34 dan campbell said of the situation 34 i mentioned this before he 39 ll take the prayers but he didn 39 t want the pity he didn 39 t want you wasting the time thinking about him he certainly doesn 39 t want us to go and not play our best ball and lose a game so that 39 s what we could do and we wanted to honor him there 39 s nothing easy about it this is hard because you do want to talk about it and acknowledge it because if you just brush it under the rug that 39 s not fair i mean the guy means too much to us and so the guys did that 34 the linebacker room knew they wanted to honor campbell at sunday 39 s game they just didn 39 t know how a few different ideas were discussed t shirts were the early answer until they realized those might take weeks to arrive they kept workshopping in search of something quick barnes spoke with lions head equipment manager tim o 39 neill and asked if he could supply the linebackers and a few defensive coaches with no 46 campbell jerseys a plan was put into motion they wore them to breakfast together they wore them into the stadium and when they arrived in the locker room the equipment team left a locker and nameplate for campbell sandwiched between derrick barnes and trevor nowaske with campbell 39 s jersey resting on a hanger 34 it was kind of a collective effort 34 said trevor nowaske campbell 39 s closest friend on the team 34 obviously this whole week 39 s been just kind of trying to support him any way we can 133 we were thinking of a couple different things and you know it 39 s just something kind of subtle to just show that no matter what he 39 s with us whether he 39 s here or not 34 barnes who wore the green dot and communicated detroit 39 s defensive calls sunday spent a little extra time on his tablet in the locker room this week like campbell typically would linebackers knew that a little bit more was expected of them from barnes to nowaske to malcolm rodriguez all three were either here before campbell joined the team or arrived the same year and on their first defensive snap of the game those three met at the line of scrimmage together and stonewalled dolphins running back ollie gordon for no gain a fitting start and a tone set 34 when we hopped up i looked around and said 39 ok 44 rodriguez there we go now aske 39 34 barnes said after the game campbell wasn 39 t out there but you wouldn 39 t know it the way this defense played without their leader they held true to their word preparing and playing like campbell it was early and often against a dolphins team that reminded lions players of themselves back in 2021 and 2022 what made it all the more impressive was that the lions weren 39 t just without campbell they were missing their best cornerback d j reed as well as starting edge rusher dj wonnum and yet this was without question their best defensive effort of the season the lions allowed a season low nine points and 228 yards of offense while controlling the line of scrimmage they held the dolphins to 77 rushing yards on 21 attempts limiting miami to zero or negative rushing yards on 28 6 percent of their attempts second best in week 9 they picked off malik willis and sacked him three times all three coming in the fourth quarter they allowed just two explosive plays on sunday a season low and they got off the field when it mattered holding miami to just 4 of 12 on third down and 0 of 3 in the red zone the dolphins could only muster three field goals each defensive stop each turnover or turnover on downs each field goal attempt players on this defense thought of 46 34 really anytime we were kind of in a rut today or they popped one or something in my head i 39 m just like 39 hey man listen if there 39 s one thing i 39 m gonna do today i 39 m gonna just go balls to the wall because i know jack would 39 34 nowaske said 34 that 39 s what i just kept coming back to and that 39 s really how i played all day 34 the lions 6 2 are playing good football right now they 39 ve won four in a row keeping pace in the toughest division in the league a defense that looked like one of the nfl 39 s worst is now rounding into form in weeks 1 4 the lions allowed 31 75 points per game second worst at the time since week 5 they rank fourth at just 15 5 and while they haven 39 t exactly faced a juggernaut in those games their efforts have directly contributed to wins picking up the slack for the offense at times between better execution the return of brian branch the looming return of kerby joseph and potential additions at the trade deadline this defense is giving folks reason to believe again even if campbell is merely a spectator in the immediate future in the meantime sunday was an ode to campbell and everything he means to this team even though campbell 39 s teammates can admit he 39 ll probably be annoyed with their gesture when they touch base 34 i already know he 39 s gonna be mad 34 nowaske said laughing 34 i know him and i know he 39 s gonna be like 39 guys what are you doing 39 but i mean we gotta show our support to our dog 34 the lions will continue to it is not customary for players on injured reserve to have a designated locker for a road game especially one they didn 39 t travel but you can make an exception for a player like campbell 34 that locker 39 s traveling and we 39 ll do our part 34 dan campbell said the lions won 39 t soon forget campbell and his contributions to this team but they understand they have a job to do to win on sunday they did it for him this article originally appeared in the athletic
